origins.neoorigins.water_mage.descriptio: Caster ito ti o nlo ṣiṣan ati awọn sisanwo iwosan. Ni ile ni okun, ṣugbọn o rọ ni awọn ilẹ gbigbẹ ogbele.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_tidal_wave.d: Fi kọnu omi kan siwaju, ṣiṣe ibajẹ 4 ati titari awọn ọta kuro. 5-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_healing_mist: Tu silẹ igbi iwosan ti o mu 6 HP pada si ọ ati awọn oṣere nitosi. Awọn idiyele 3 mana. 10-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_aquatic.name: Olomi
power.neoorigins.water_mage_moisture_reg: Laiyara tun ilera pada lakoko ti o wa ninu omi.
Ṣe ibajẹ ni awọn aginju ati awọn ilẹ buburu - afẹfẹ gbigbẹ n gba agbara rẹ.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_fragile.name: ẹlẹgẹ
power.neoorigins.water_mage_fragile.desc: Mu 25% dinku bibajẹ melee. Agbara rẹ nṣan nipasẹ omi, kii ṣe iṣan.
origins.neoorigins.fire_mage.name: Ina Mage
origins.neoorigins.fire_mage.description: Piromancer kan ti o ni iyipada ti a fi iná kun - sọ awọn bọọlu ina, ti nwaye sinu ina, o si jo awọn ti o lù ọ. Ina ko le ṣe ipalara fun ọ, ṣugbọn omi ni iyipada rẹ.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fireball.name: Bọọlu ina
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fireball.desc: Kọ volley kan ti awọn bọọlu ina kekere mẹrin si itọsọna ti o n wa. Awọn idiyele 3 mana. 4-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_inferno_burst: Tu ina ti nwaye ti o ba gbogbo awọn ọta wa nitosi. Awọn idiyele 3 mana. 8-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_flame_cloak.d: Awọn ikọlu gba 30% ti ibajẹ ti wọn ṣe bi igbẹsan ina.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fire_immunity: Ajesara si ina, lava, ati ibajẹ block magma. Lava gbona lasan.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_water_weaknes: Mu 1 bibajẹ fun iṣẹju kan nigba ti omi tabi ojo.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_hunger.name: Ti abẹnu ileru
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_hunger.descri: Ebi drains 50% yiyara lati ooru laarin.
origins.neoorigins.air_mage.name: Air Mage
origins.neoorigins.air_mage.description: Afẹfẹ afẹfẹ ti o yara ti o ju awọn idiyele afẹfẹ lọ, ti o nfọn iji ti iṣipopada, ti o si gun awọn ilọsiwaju si ọrun. Imọlẹ bi afẹfẹ, ṣugbọn alailagbara bi ewe kan.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_wind_charge.de: Iyaworan a afẹfẹ idiyele ti o ṣẹda a ti nwaye knockback lori ikolu.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_whirlwind.name: Afẹfẹ
power.neoorigins.air_mage_whirlwind.desc: Ja boluti afẹfẹ kan ti o fa iji lile lori ipa - fa, gbe soke, ati yiyi awọn nkan ti o wa nitosi fun iṣẹju-aaya mẹrin. Awọn idiyele 4 mana.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_updraft.name: Igbesoke
power.neoorigins.air_mage_updraft.descri: Lọlẹ ara rẹ si ọrun lori ọwọn ti afẹfẹ.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_no_fall_damage: Afẹfẹ afẹfẹ isubu rẹ - iwọ ko gba ibajẹ isubu.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_zephyr.name: Zephyr
power.neoorigins.air_mage_zephyr.descrip: Ti a gbe nipasẹ awọn afẹfẹ iru ibakan - gbe 20% yiyara ni ẹsẹ.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_slow_fall.name: Ibalẹ
power.neoorigins.air_mage_slow_fall.desc: Sọkalẹ rọra, bi ẹnipe agbara walẹ ko kan. Paa pẹlu bọtini olorijori nigbati o nilo lati ju silẹ ni iyara.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_fragile.name: Fireemu ẹlẹgẹ
power.neoorigins.air_mage_fragile.descri: -2 ọkàn (-4 max HP). Ara ti afẹfẹ ko ni itumọ ti lati ṣiṣe.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_light.name: Ìwúwo Fúyẹ́
power.neoorigins.air_mage_light.descript: Mu 50% knockback diẹ sii - afẹfẹ gbe ọ ni irọrun pupọ.
origins.neoorigins.gravity_mage.name: Mage Walẹ
origins.neoorigins.gravity_mage.descript: A jagunjagun ti awọn aaye gravitational ti o tẹ aaye funrararẹ. Fa awọn ọta rẹ sinu ẹyọkan ti o fọ tabi fọ wọn kuro - ṣugbọn ara ti ara rẹ ko ni isokan kuro ni ilẹ.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_well.name: Walẹ Daradara
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_well.descr: Ṣe ina orb dudu ti o ṣubu sinu iho dudu lori ipa. Awọn nkan ti o wa nitosi ni a fa si aarin rẹ ki o ba bajẹ fun iṣẹju-aaya mẹrin. Awọn idiyele 4 mana. 20-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_repulse.de: Tu silẹ igbi shockwaji kan ti o bu gbogbo awọn nkan ti o wa nitosi kuro. Awọn idiyele 3 mana. 4-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_levitation: Toggleable: defy walẹ ati dide lori pipaṣẹ (Levitation I). Paa nipasẹ aiyipada - yi pada pẹlu bọtini olorijori.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_no_fall_da: O ko le gba bibajẹ isubu.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_unmoored.d: Mu 75% knockback diẹ sii - agbara walẹ rẹ jẹ ki o rọrun lati ṣe ifilọlẹ.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_frail.name: Alailagbara
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_frail.desc: Mu 25% dinku bibajẹ melee. Agbara rẹ wa ninu fifa, kii ṣe punch.
origins.neoorigins.darkness_mage.name: Òkunkun Mage
origins.neoorigins.darkness_mage.descrip: Oṣó ti o n hun ojiji ti o pe awọn orbs ojiji ti o yipo ati awọn igbesẹ laarin awọn adagun okunkun. Aṣọ ati apaniyan ni alẹ, ṣugbọn imọlẹ oorun n jo agbara rẹ kuro.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_or: Gbe orb ojiji kan si ipo rẹ ti o fa Okunkun ati afọju lori awọn ọta nitosi. Titi di orbs 3 ṣiṣẹ ni ẹẹkan. Awọn idiyele 3 mana. 5-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_st: Teleport si ibiti o n wa, to awọn bulọọki 24 kuro. Awọn idiyele 2 mana. 4-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_night_vis: Wo kedere ninu okunkun lapapọ. Yipada pẹlu bọtini Iran Alẹ (aiyipada K).
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_cl: Awọn agbajo eniyan rii ọ lati 40% ti iwọn deede wọn.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_sunburn.d: Mu ipalara 1 fun iṣẹju kan ni imọlẹ orun taara.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_light_sen: Mi 30% losokepupo - ina ti awọn ipele ti o farahan n ta oju rẹ.
neoorigins.configuration.hide_hud_bars: Tọju awọn ifi HUD ti ko lo
neoorigins.configuration.origins: Awọn orisun ti a ṣe sinu
neoorigins.configuration.classes: Awọn kilasi ti a ṣe sinu
neoorigins.configuration.ocean_origins.d: Bibajẹ ti o ṣubu ni iṣẹju-aaya
